text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-e-d a b-e-l-i-e-v-a-b-l-e r-o-m-a-n-c-e p-e-r-s-o-n-a for l-o-n-g-d-i-s-t-a-n-c-e i-n-t-e-r-a-c-t-i-o-n-s and l-e-f-t c-h-a-t l-o-g-s as a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
2) the a-c-t-o-r s-e-n-t a s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e of t-r-u-s-t-b-u-i-l-d-i-n-g m-e-s-s-a-g-e-s over w-e-e-k-s and l-e-f-t m-e-t-a-d-a-t-a trails while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g f-r-a-u-d-r-i-s-k m-o-d-e-r-a-t-i-o-n.
3) the a-c-t-o-r e-x-t-r-a-c-t-e-d e-m-e-r-g-e-n-c-y p-a-y-m-e-n-t-s under p-r-e-s-s-u-r-e and l-e-f-t t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r r-e-c-e-i-p-t-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l r-e-d-f-l-a-g r-e-v-i-e-w-s.
4) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-c-r-u-i-t-e-d m-o-n-e-y m-u-l-e-s for c-o-v-e-r-e-d m-o-v-e-m-e-n-t-s and l-e-f-t m-u-l-e n-a-m-e l-i-s-t-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g k-n-o-w-n m-u-l-e n-e-t-w-o-r-k c-r-o-s-s-c-h-e-c-k-s.
5) the a-c-t-o-r i-s-s-u-e-d i-n-s-t-r-u-c-t-i-o-n-s to p-r-e-v-e-n-t v-i-c-t-i-m c-o-m-p-a-r-i-s-o-n of n-o-t-e-s and l-e-f-t i-s-o-l-a-t-i-o-n d-i-r-e-c-t-i-v-e-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t r-e-p-o-r-t-i-n-g d-e-t-e-r-r-e-n-t s-c-r-e-e-n-i-n-g.
